summary:
Space Legacy Museum is an interactive digital museum that explores the history of space exploration through important spacecraft and technological achievements from 1960 to the present day.
The project presents significant spacecraft, satellites, space telescopes, and exploration vehicles through visual exhibits and informative descriptions. Visitors can discover how space technology has evolved over the decades and test their knowledge through interactive questions.
Our main goal is to make the history of space exploration accessible, educational, and engaging while celebrating humanity’s achievements beyond Earth.
details: Space Legacy Museum is an interactive digital museum that introduces the history of space exploration from the 1960s to the present day. It works by presenting important spacecraft, satellites, rovers, and space telescopes through visual exhibits, historical information, and interactive questions. Visitors can explore the exhibits, learn about different space missions, and test their knowledge. The project benefits students, teachers, and space enthusiasts by making scientific information more accessible, educational, and enjoyable. Its intended impact is to increase interest in space exploration, encourage scientific curiosity, and help people understand how space technology has evolved over time. We developed the project using Genially to create the interactive museum and used NASA’s open data resources and image library for reliable information and visual materials. No additional coding languages or specialized hardware were required. The creative aspect of our project is its combination of a traditional museum experience with interactive digital learning. Our team considered accuracy, accessibility, visual design, educational value, and ease of navigation to ensure that visitors of different ages could enjoy and understand the museum.
